# ANURRAKTI

> ANURRAKTI is an Indian fashion house creating singular clothing through textile, emotion and considered design.

Site: https://www.anurrakti.com
Sitemap: https://www.anurrakti.com/sitemap.xml
Language: English (India)

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.anurrakti.com/): The ANURRAKTI world, campaign imagery, collection entry points and private enquiry.
- [About ANURRAKTI](https://www.anurrakti.com/about): The house, its point of view and its approach to textile, memory and considered design.
- [Collections](https://www.anurrakti.com/collection): EHSAAS and RAGA collection entry point.
- [EHSAAS](https://www.anurrakti.com/collection/ehsaas): The EHSAAS saree collection.
- [RAGA](https://www.anurrakti.com/collection/raga): The RAGA saree collection.
- [The House](https://www.anurrakti.com/house): Brand point of view and craft language.
- [Saree Guides and Stories](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs): The ANURRAKTI journal index.
- [Ready to Wear](https://www.anurrakti.com/ready-to-wear): Forthcoming ready-to-wear expression.
- [Contact](https://www.anurrakti.com/contact): Enquiry form, WhatsApp, telephone and Instagram contact options.

## Saree guides

- [Types of Sarees in India](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/types-of-sarees-in-india): Eight regional saree traditions, their origins and defining characteristics.
- [How to Choose a Saree for Every Occasion](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/how-to-choose-saree-for-every-occasion): A practical framework based on role, formality, place, movement and the complete look.
- [How to Choose a Saree for Your Body Type](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/how-to-choose-saree-for-your-body-type): Styling principles centred on proportion, comfort and personal preference.
- [How to Drape a Saree](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/how-to-drape-a-saree): A step-by-step beginner's guide to preparing, pleating and securing a saree.
- [How to Care for Sarees](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/how-to-care-for-sarees): Washing, handling and storage guidance across common saree materials.
- [Saree Fabrics Explained](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/saree-fabrics-explained): An introduction to silk, cotton, blends and construction terminology.
- [How to Choose a Saree Blouse](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/how-to-choose-saree-blouse): Fit, fabric and design considerations for a saree blouse.
- [Saree Colour Combinations](https://www.anurrakti.com/blogs/saree-colour-combinations): A practical guide to hue, value, contrast and colour relationships.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.anurrakti.com/privacy): How ANURRAKTI collects, uses, shares and protects information.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.anurrakti.com/terms): Terms governing use of the website and private enquiries.

## Contact

Private enquiry is available through the [Contact page](https://www.anurrakti.com/contact), WhatsApp, telephone and Instagram.

## Content notes

- Product availability is confirmed through private enquiry; the website does not provide public checkout.
- Blog articles identify ANURRAKTI Editorial as the author and include visible sources and further reading.
- Canonical URLs and the XML sitemap are the authoritative indexes for current content.
